hero.body: lets you combine the advantages of deterministic algorithms, quant analytics and machine learning to form an asset management platform specifically designed for you.

profit.intro: redefines profitability by eliminating third-party fees, management costs, and emotional trading. Instead of chasing alpha, it secures your wealth through cold, rational, and rules-based execution—managing your assets 24/7 strictly according to your parameters.

p1.text: You keep 100% of your returns. There are no depot fees, no fund management charges, and no hidden sales commissions eating into your capital.

p2.text: Human trading is driven by fear and greed. The system executes your strategy with cold, mathematical precision—never panicking during market drops or chasing hype.

p3.text: The market never truly sleeps, and neither does your platform. Your assets are continuously monitored and adjusted strictly according to your predefined parameters.

p4.text: Trades are strictly gated by logic. Execution only happens when fixed, hardcoded criteria are met—no fuzzy drift, no manual overrides, just pure strategy execution.

audit.intro: prioritizes absolute transparency over black-box LLMs. Every system action is immutably logged, fully comprehensible, and strictly complies with legal frameworks.

p1.text: System decisions are securely archived. By utilizing tamper-evident storage layers, every single execution is logged in a strictly revision-proof format.

p2.text: Unlike standard AI models, the pipeline is entirely inspectable. Every classifier vote carries a clear, written reasoning string so you understand every move.

p3.text: Legal frameworks are strictly maintained at the software level. Complex anti-market-abuse and compliance checks run deterministically before any order routing.

p4.text: Absolute transparency means you are never in the dark. The detailed logging infrastructure ensures every past decision remains crystal clear and verifiable.

safe.intro: engineers safety through absolute data sovereignty. It connects peer-to-peer to your broker, shielding your personal financial data from third parties.

p1.text: Your platform communicates directly with your broker via secure APIs. No middlemen, no cloud intermediaries, and zero personal data shared with third parties.

p2.text: No cloud AI reads your strategies. Local LLMs analyze the markets directly on your hardware, guaranteeing that your personal financial moves remain a secret.

p3.text: Hardened against external manipulation. You hold a master kill-switch to halt all trading instantly, 24/7.

p4.text: Your capital is structurally safe from theft. The system only possesses trading permissions—it is entirely incapable of transferring money out of your brokerage account.
